**Analysis of Previous Result:**
Web results show that Philip of Ibelin’s mother is Maria Komnene (Μαρία Κομνηνή), the dowager queen of Jerusalem, linking her to the Byzantine Komnenos dynasty.

**Updated Understanding:**
Philip d'Ibelin (1180–1227) was the son of Balian d’Ibelin and Maria Komnene. Maria Komnene’s mother was Maria Taronitissa of the Taronites family (of Armenian origin). Therefore, treating medieval “nationality” as maternal ethnic origin, her nationality is Armenian.
